== Description ==

[[Randy Scott]] (main subject, Colorado Avalanche cap, glasses, beard, black hoodie over a blue Tatooine tee, name tag “Randy / DirtyRandy”, blue card sleeves) and [[Phil Aasen]] (background, grey flat cap, black SEL/North Face jacket, beard, in profile at the next table) at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 4 October 2025.
